title: RAW UNREVIEWED: explanation-first and consequence-first redactions preserve one ordered causal claim
summary: A compiler abridges explanations using two recurring discourse templates: P, therefore Q; Q, because P. Surface clause order reverses while semantic cause-to-consequence direction remains fixed. RAW_UNREVIEWED; no target reading or word assignment.

design.access: Existing route, topic and bounded registry navigation only. No target payload, new images, reserves, fits or new source acquisitions in this pass.
design.claim_ceiling: A proposed authoring mechanism, not a manuscript finding or historical attestation. No Voynich form receives a meaning. A confirmed word is not required to draft the hypothesis; candidate word assignments nevertheless require profiles and complete prior counterexamples before use.
design.positive_structure: Reusable directed composition, hierarchical spaces, whole-form residuals and entry effects; adjacency transfer across sections/hands with weaker transfer of direction; known r/l phrase transfer but failure on new stem combinations. These are structural observations, not semantic support for this proposal.
design.retained_failures: GDT915 mixed cells and GDT916 new-stem failure, W89 recipe pause, GDT1153 fixed anaphora failure, GDT1163 correlative failure, GDT1164/1166 writing-channel failures and partial f38v whole-chain draft remain unchanged. No f38v restart or control repair.
design.mechanism: A compiler abridges explanations using two recurring discourse templates: P, therefore Q; Q, because P. Surface clause order reverses while semantic cause-to-consequence direction remains fixed.
design.complete_content_construction: A condition P produces effect Q; Q licenses recommendation R under qualifier C. One redaction writes P then Q then the qualified recommendation; another begins with Q, supplies P as explanation, and preserves the same qualified recommendation. Rival keeps written clause order as causal direction and therefore claims Q causes P.
design.finite_consequence: Two separately used connectives/templates must transform clause order without reversing the shared P-to-Q dependency. The Q-to-R link and C scope must also persist, preventing a free two-clause exchange from counting as complete agreement. This does not equate causal implication with its logical converse.
design.authoring_step: Start from a report-owned repeated construction family with its full surrounding entries, not an isolated bigram. Draft the two complete explanatory redactions and the order-following rival under one grammar; require a second predicate pair to use the same reversal rule. Keep topic roots anonymous and all unknowns visible.
design.frequency_obligation: Candidate discourse constructions must respect exact-form profiles and distribution across themes; transferred adjacency but weaker directional transfer motivates testing discourse reordering, not assuming it. Known r/l mixed cells and new-stem transfer failure preclude automatic universal suffix assignment.
design.difference: A cross-entry redaction law reversing surface clause order while preserving a two-edge explanation/recommendation chain; no fixed therefore word or reflexive relation map is inherited.
design.likely_failure: Both templates could be found only through freely chosen segmentation. A shared clause permutation could describe noncausal relations equally well. The account must name this remaining ambiguity and cannot claim because/therefore merely from an order pattern.
